intent: Compare the Remain and Leave polling shares over the final month before the referendum to determine which side led for most of that period.

requirements.question: Are all required line series shown in every declared panel?
Which side had the higher polling share at the final polling point?

units.claim: All 2 required series appear in panel single chart.
accept: every required series is visible and correctly labeled in this panel
reject: series assigned to the wrong panel

units.claim: At the final polling point on June 23, 2016, Remain's share was 48% and Leave's share was 46%, so Remain was still higher at the final point.
accept: Remain leads Leave at the final point.
reject: Leave leads Remain at the final point.
Remain and Leave are equal at the final point.

optional_valid: Remain's share declined from 48.5333% at point_order 222 to 48.0% at the final point, while Leave's share rose from 45.6750% to 46.0%.
Determining which side led for most of the final month is optional_valid for V1 because most intermediate x values are blank; the removed required comparison used the unlabeled point_order 222.
unsupported_to_avoid: Claiming Leave led for most of the final month without checking intermediate points.
review_notes: The intent asks which side led for most of the final month; the table summary does not provide x-values for intermediate points in the final month, so only the start and end of that window can be verified. The claim in U2 was corrected to reflect Remain > Leave at the final point.
Closure truth correction 2026-10-29: claims, ranges, computations, and relations were checked against data_table.csv.
Closure adjudication 2026-10-29: data_table.csv is authoritative; unlabeled plotted turns are retained when they belong to the series.
